verdicts.reason: A suits the 300x250 near-square format. It keeps the original's stacked hierarchy: the FIZZBANG! pill is clearly dominant and the SINCE 2026 badge sits centred below it. The only flaw is that it is mostly a uniform scale-down, with slightly loose space below the badge. B places the pill and badge side by side, which shrinks the logo pill so that the subordinate SINCE 2026 badge competes with it at nearly the same height. The two are jammed together with almost no gutter, the badge runs close to the right edge, and big empty halftone bands are left above and below. That breaks both the hierarchy and the balance.
